correctness.rationale: Work in Z[[q]] with A(q)=∏(1−q^j). The p-adic lifting lemma H(q)^(p^r)≡H(q^p)^(p^(r−1)) mod p^r follows from Frobenius and binomial valuations. Apply it along A(q)^(p^(2a)) to A(q^(p^a))^(p^a) for t=p^a, obtaining mod p^(a+1). The first a−1 steps imply mod p^(a+2) through degree p^(a−1)−1, while direct linear coefficient of A(q^(p^(a−1)))^(p^(a+1)) is −p^(a+1), proving sharpness. For t=p^a u, u>1,p∤u, Frobenius mod p first differs at degree p^(2a) by −u²; gcd divides t² from coefficient n=1, hence 1 for nonprimepower. Independent exact integer Euler-product recurrence computed all coefficients through degree 120 for 20 t cases, reproducing prime-power gcd/first failure and nonprimepower p-obstructions.
